title: trustedHosts: [] in the loaded patch -> blocked (the remote UI opens, every /api call is 403)
titleZh: 已加载 patch 里 trustedHosts: [] -> blocked(界面能开、/api 全 403)
why: This is the measured failure mode of the broken trust fence: the page loads, the client loops on 'reconnecting', and nothing says why. A present trustedHosts key whose values do not match the tailnet authority must be blocked, not unknown: the value was read, it is simply wrong.
inject: the whole patch chain replaced by one file that carries trustedHosts: []
expectSummary: TRUSTED_HOSTS_PATCH blocked/th_blocked with a rollback, exit 2

patch_files.text:
- id: web-runtime
  config:
    openBrowser: false
    trustedHosts: []
